approved_behavior_changes: Recovery log follows final aggregate plus every-active-symbol freshness result. Freshness exceptions fail closed.
Only valid aware nonfuture ordered bar timestamps may advance history; duplicate corrections replace without renewing freshness.
A newer but already stale bar supports ordered history without refreshing prior health; first old bar uses historical timestamp.
Backward/nonfinite clock cannot be laundered by an advancing callback.
Subscribed unseen symbols block entries; confirmed unsubscribe removes obsolete bars/quotes/freshness while failure retains state for retry.
Late retired callbacks are ignored until explicit resubscription; independent bar/quote subscription retry handles partial success.
Failed start subscriptions disconnect before retry; failed disconnect preserves old stream reference.
All-stale reconnect preserves bar health; no-first-bar startup reconnect grace retained.
preserved: Every active stale symbol can block the global entry gate.
120-second freshness thresholds and actual-feature final-entry gate.
REST data can support features/exits without clearing streaming entry block.
Quote traffic does not establish bar freshness; quote execution-age policy unchanged.
Protective exits, EOD entry block and flatten, feed, sizing and strategy parameters unchanged.

Subscription True denotes successful local send/tracking, not a new remote acknowledgement protocol.
Fresh advancing bar health retains receipt-age semantics; final actual-feature age guard remains independently required.
Any deployment requires explicit frozen-surface transition/new forward cutoff, reviewed PR/CI, runtime snapshot and controlled rollout.
